symptom: Numeric inspector fields committed each arrow keyup, so one ArrowUp tap wrote immediately, Escape could not revert it, and the design-style-refinements smoke went red on main.
rule: Arrow stepping in an inspector field previews only; it commits once on Enter or blur, Escape restores the value from before the sequence, and the field stays dirty for Save while a previewed step is pending.
check: pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/design-workspace/__tests__/design-inspector-scrub-renders.test.ts -t 'previews numeric arrow stepping immediately and commits once on Enter'
